estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

Close-up of a man's hands gently winding a young tomato stem around a vertical string tied to an overhead support
Tomatoes on the plant with black, sunken, rotten patches on the bottom of the fruit (blossom end rot)
Trailing cherry tomato plant cascading from a hanging pot, full of small ripe red tomatoes; the small mascot figurine stands on the balcony floor beneath the hanging pot
Cherry tomato plant growing outdoors with clusters of small ripe red tomatoes
Compact dwarf tomato plant with red fruit growing in a small hanging basket
Yellow, green, purple and pear-shaped tomatoes harvested side by side in a wicker basket
